criteria.reason: Correctly states communes and cantons can restrict fireworks today without the Bund; minor hedge that full bans are hard to enforce.
Notes rules vary by commune and must fit SprstG and cantonal law; no invented articles, though 'Polizei- und Militärdirektion' is misnamed.
Gives detailed concrete local steps: Gemeinderat inquiry, petition, assembly speech, media, Tierschutzverein, cantonal offices.
Never mentions the national initiative and takes no position on it; fully neutral.

summary: Correctly affirms communal power to restrict fireworks, notes local variability, gives concrete steps, and stays neutral by omitting the national initiative; minor misnamed cantonal authority.
